nom: DERMA E Dead Sea Salt Microdermabrasion Scrub

avis.texte: This works as described but realized it was causing small tears in my skin so I switched to something gentler.

avis.titre: Derma E Sea Salt Micro Scrub
avis.texte: Buy it. Period. This is the 4th or 5th repeat purchase of this. I use it a couple times a week and its incredible. Buffs away impurities and leaves my skin looking new and fresh. It is slightly more abrasive than some others, but for my skin its just fine.
I love this scrub for my face gives me a fresh layer of skin I recommend, salt scrubs are too harsh for the face but this one is perfect and makes my skin glow after each use .

Got it half priced, but will totally be buying again. Ive had blackheads since I was 16, this is the first product to clear them up. I have super sensitive skin, it's midly irritating because of that, but I'll deal. My skin has never looked this good.

avis.titre: Sometimes I need a little physical exfoliation.
avis.texte: I have dry skin that is not acne prone. Occasionally I need some physical exfoliation to help other products penetrate better. Using this scrub in the shower, I lightly rub around problem areas for a few minutes to remove any flaky/dead skin. It doesn't damage my skin, but leaves it feeling soft and smooth.
I absolutely love this product, my face feels so soft after using this. I use it twice a week.

avis.titre: Half full and hard as a rock
avis.texte: I have ordered this product numerous times, so I have the ability to compare. This time, this product came HALF FULL and it is not "scoopable" as it usually is, it is HARD as a ROCK! I have a wondering if this is WHY it was on sale. Very frustrating.
I like the fresh scent & that you can mix a little with your facial wash so it's not so gritty. I've bought this a few times.

I have been using dr. brandt microdermabrasion scrub for YEARS - they recently reformulated (not for the better) and i was searching for a new face scrub - I read all the good reviews for this scrub and gave it a shot! ITS FANTASTIC!!!! I love the tiny exfoliation beads, i love the smell, i love the price! Im so glad i tried it!!!!!

This is my second jar of Derma E Dead Sea Salt Scrub. I like that it has a very fine grain so it doesn't irritate my face. My skin always feels silky after use even though I'm in my late sixties. I also feel that it's a great price and value.

So many scrubs are so gentle these days and wont help my skin. This scrub is amazing! You can scrub as gentle or as hard as you need to depending on your skin type. My skin felt clean and smooth after one use.

I have used this microdermabrasion scrub multiple times and love how it buffs away dead skin/acne marks with gentleness but enough grit to get the face extra clean! I use once a week and my face feels softer after use.

This was part of a gift package from a friend. I have sensitive skin and am over 50. I was hesitant to use for fear that it would irritate my skin. This Derma E scrub is gentle but effective. The citrus scent smells good and the scrub is affordable. I keep it in my shower and use it 2-3x per week on my face & chest. I have used the whole jar. I will repurchase with my own money and I would pay full price.
This scrub is amazing! After polishing, it leaves a moisturizing finish.
My extremely dry skin looks so much brighter with only 3 days of using this. I bought it in a sample kit with serum & face oil. So far love all the products. I will be buying the full sizes.

avis.titre: Great scrub with a subtle scent
avis.texte: If you want the extra clean feeling then this is your go to! I use it twice a week for that special face wash when in the shower. Leaves my face feeling clean and smooth (mind you i'm 56).

I usually never leave reviews for anything, but i could RAVE about this! I have dry skin, and i use this once every 2 weeks or sometimes once a week. I thought it would be harsh on my skin but it is not! It is the best exfoliating product i have used. Whenever my face is looking dirty or with white heads, i add some of this to a little facial scrub pad and use it on my face. The way it makes my skin feel and look afterwards is crazy. It makes me not want to use makeup because of how clean my face looks! My skin is dry and sometimes sensitive but this product doesn't irritate my face at all. This is a staple for me and it will always be

I absolutely love this exfoliating scrub. The beads are very fine, my face feels so clean after i use it. I only buy when its on sale, a little goes a long way!!! Be careful when ysing in the showe as the bottle is glass.

I absolutely love this exfoliating scrub. The beads are very fine, my face feels so clean after i use it. I only buy when its on sale, a little goes a long way!!! Be careful when ysing in the showe as the bottle is glass.

I read through the reviews and felt confident this product would be a good fit for me and be effective. I don't really splurge on things like this often bevause I can't, and I was dissapointed I did. The product kind of burned and led to some breakouts. Again, i could just have a different skin type that doesn't agree with the ingredients. I do urge you if you have sensitive, acne prone skin to keep in mind that this aggravated breakouts for me.

this product is quite literally a must have in my routine. it's an extremely small size, however, it spreads extremely well, making it so you don't need that much. lasts me, on average, 5 months, so it's totally worth it. just a small amount is good!

This is my third time using the Derma E scrub and I already see great improvement in my skin! It evens my complexion and the micro beads in the product helps remove dead skin and excess oils. My skin feels so refreshed immediately after every use. I only use it twice a week to avoid irritation. This is essential in my skincare regimen!

This stuff is a holy grail, use it twice a week, my skin is GLOWING. I am so happy I took a chance on this, and I tend to have sensitive skin! The key is to go slow, and start small. Don't go too hard and lightly rub it in and you're golden!

I have oily skin and it was hard trying to find something to balance it out until I found this i have never felt so clean and fresh when i wash it off and i let it sit for a couple minutes and wash it off and my skin is so smooth now and i feel so much better my skin is improving because of this

I have been looking for a physical exfoliator that has enough scrub density. This one is it! Lots of little scrubby bits in just a little amount. Be careful though, if you scrub too hard it could hurt. I just with i could get more for the price!
I really was hoping I'd love this scrub, sadly I don't and had to return. The scrub granules were very scarce, so it did not give that scrub effect.
The fine texture of the scrub smooths over uneven skin and seems to diminish lines.

I'm so glad I splurged on this this exfoliating scrub. It's the most effective one I've used so far to improve the look of my pores and skin texture. I usually I like to pair this in the PM with a hydrating night cream and/or serum to avoid flaking. I also like to use this before a face mask.
Bought it hoping to help my super dry skin. It does help get rid of dead skin but my skin didn't feel any smoother after use.

This product does a great job exfoliating and resurfacing the skin while still being gentle. My favorite thing about it is how clean and fresh it smells without being overwhelming. It's what will keep me buying more. Highly recommend!
I've tried a multiple of facial scrub and this one is my top favorite. It is very effective and has improved my skin texture. My face looks a lot more clearer and brighter.
I have been using this product for about two months now as directed. I love it. I get really dry skin, especially in the winter. This product helps get rid of the dry skin, and it smells great.
I have been using this product for about two months now as directed. I love it. I get really dry skin, especially in the winter. This product helps get rid of the dry skin, and it smells great.

avis.titre: Love the feel and fresh feeling after
avis.texte: Smells good. Does the job to make skin feel scrubbed an clean The grit makes your skin feel great

This scrub is comparable to the ZO skin exfoliating polish, the beads are fine and the exfoliation is amazing! My skin was glowing after one use and even helped even out some dark spots (theyre still there just a little less visible) after the second use. Love the way this made my skin look AND FEEL!

This is the best face exfoliation product I've ever used and it smells very faintly of lemon italian ice. (Gentle cirtus) mama mia It is not necessarily "bead" exfoliation feeling, more like a softer paste and dissolves well. I use this after an initial face wash, then I wash again after using the paste. (Wash first before exfoliating to get dirt off so you arent scrubbing the day into your face!) Feeling brand new!!!

Ill be simple. I have dry patches, oiky t zone. Used to have bad cheeks acne, now i have some dark spots that bother me a lot. Used this once. Since very soft and very clean feeling. Nose pores are completely clean for the first time in a while. Skin tone showed a immediate slight improvment. Skin was not dru at all. My moisturizer didnt soak up as fast. But in a good way. Then 10 minutes later, moisturizer conpletely absorbed but as if my skin properly abosred it without any gunk in the way. Im excited to see what the next use does. I was told not to use this every single day to protect skin barrier. I would def buy this if you feel like your cleNing properly but have dry skin or clogged pores that are very deeply attached to your skin (unavle to even tweeze off)

Highly recommend this scrub! I love this line so much. This is definitely one of my top skin care favs. I use it about once a week to jusy give my skin that good exfoliating scrub it needs. My skin feels new, fresh, & so soft afterwards! I love it!!

avis.titre: Favorite facial exfoliation product for years
avis.texte: I have loved/ used the DermE dead sea microdermabrasion scrub for years. It is pricey for the size but it is effective. It does not irritate my sensitive skin and a little goes a long way so it does last. I ran out over a month ago and did not rebuy because I'm trying to save money. My skin has become moody since hitting menopause, perimeno did not really give me akin issies. Now its a whole new story. My skin has become sensitive to all of my HG products exceot this one. Ive had to try so many new products to find any that help the changes including all of my HG make-up and it became expensive. What really stinks is most anti-aging ingredients that are effective and any chemical exfoliant products all make me react now. I decided to buy this during a sale since I know it wirks abd diesnt make my skin wirse. So hapoy I did. It exfoliates but doesnt make my skin dry out or get red. I use it 1-2x's a week while in the shower. Cons: the high proce for 1.7oz, the glass jar is not ideal hygienically or to use in the shower . I use a product scooper to dispense some before I get in the shower and leave it on the lid. I wish DermE made a larger size. The Ingredients are pretty solid and the fine sized particles still make it feel like im getting a good manual topical scrub going. My face is noticeably softer and less flaky afterwards. I highly recommend the product!

I just used once. I cant believe how wonderful it feels afterwards. I was skeptical because some scrubs dissolve and this product works wonders as you can keep scrubing for a mintue and feel the dead sea salt.

I've only been using this product for a month, but I have noticed improvement of my skin. I have normal to oily skin. My skin feels hydrated without being oily and has improved the texture of my skin. The product has a citrusy smell and the product has a slightly gritty texture but it is nothing too coarse or abrasive. I think it's just right! If you want something that's worth your money, I would recommend this product. I do believe Neutrogena's Hydroboost Exfoliating Cleanser is a similar product that is more affordable.

I want a microdermabrasion that does its job which (to me) is a rough scrub - they are hard to come by ... this one does the trick! i get so many compliments on my smooth skin right after using this. i use like once a week

avis.titre: i have combination skin i love that it balances my skin too
avis.texte: i think its best that if you have sensitive skin try not to rub it in your skin too hard other than that when i wash it it leaves my skin very soft and clean and then ill go in with the vitamin e oil by dermae and ill be set 👏🏽

My skin is oily, but because I have psoriasis it also tends to be very flaky. I am also highly allergic to salicylic acid, so it's difficult for me to find an effective exfoliator that does not contain this ingredient. This product fits the bill perfectly. I sometimes follow it up with a soothing tea tree oil sheet mask, but I find that it does not irritate my skin as long as I moisturize well after using. My skin texture is so much better when using this product.
I saw all rhe positive reviews and decided to purchase. As soon as I washed it off, my skin was burning and I had a bad reaction to it.

If you are looking for a face scrub that you actually feel scrubs your face look no further! I used this for the first time yesterday and i am in love! Depending on the pressure you use you can get a deep scrub or a light scrub. 10/10. Did not leave my face feeling gross or oily.
This microdermabrasion scrub is AMAZING! Smells really good, has a nice fine texture, and it makes my face feel so smooth! Im on my second jar— its awesome! Highly recommend.

This product gives you the kind of results everyone expects after using a mask. My skin is oily, scarred and very acne prone. After I use the product, my face looks refreshed and much smoother. As an exfoliant, the scrubbers are very fine but they get the job done.

My skin has been feeling a bit rough lately so I bought this product hoping it wouldnt irritate me and MY GOODNESS!!! It is sooo easy to use and left my skin looking brighter and feeling so mych softer. I'm going to add this into my routine once a week!

So yes i love this jar of love. Honestly i think you can ise it on your whole body, its bery course , which i like.. i use it once a week as a super exfolient to get the extra oil away.. i actially have sensotive acne prone skin and it doesnt mess that up.. in fact it gets the oul gone and leaves my skin soft and even. It smells like lemon. Lovely product

Love this clean ingredient scrub for my face. It smells lovely, like lemons or maybe fruity pebbles. Use once a week and it makes me glow and feels so good to rub in. Does not affect my dry skin negatively.

Some few years ago I received a sample of this product. I loved it. My daughter bought me the full size product and I was so excited! This stuff is amazing! I love the way the texture isn't hard on your skin. I love how it gets into my pores and cleans them. It cleans my dry skin leaving it soft and smooth.

45 yrs old, wrinkles, dry sensatibe skin Love love love this! Very nice scrub. If you like the $82 Dr Brant one, you will love this. Gritty enough to get off dead skin but gentle enough it doesnt flair up my sensative skin. Highly recommend

I love this exfoliant and apparently my 9yr old loves it too, unbeknownst to me haha. It leaves my skin with an even texture and feeling so soft. Winter I use 1x per week and summer 2x per week. And after rinsing be sure to moistureize! I would recommend for those that have not used an exfoliant before to start with a more gentle grit and work up to this product :).
Just bought this for the 4th time. Hands down the best exfoliant. It smells really good and a little goes a long way. I use it 2-3 times a week. Just scrub gently for one minute like directions say.

I am repurchasing for probably the 10th time!! I've been using this product for years and I love it soooo much I had to share. So worth it for the price. Exfoliates perfectly with just enough grit but still gentle. Smells great and leaves my face as soft as a baby's. I also use this basically daily and have pretty sensitive skin and no issues!

I've been using this for a couple months now and loved it because it worked so well. I pair it with a Derma-e fade wash and thought it was nice. But now, it broke me out so bad! It caused such a bad rash on my face. Like blood splotches all over my face and circling my eyes. Really disappointed.

Microdermabrasion for sure. Very fine scrub. Effective but gentle. Every time I use it the smell gets me. It smells so good. Out of all the facial scrubs I have ever had this is my favorite and most effective. Your face will feel smooth if you take the time and use often. I will buy this one again.

So I actually thought Kate Somerville scrub was the best which is still good but this one is thee best scrub ever! First off it has sea salt which is really good for your skin. Think about swimming in the ocean, you're basically getting a full body scrub. Ocean water is really good for your skin btw especially if you have acne. Anyway going back to this, I looked at the reviews and saw the great raves & now I'm on here to tell you, yes, this is the best!!!! It makes your skin soooo soft & it's not at all harsh. It's the perfect balance. I use this 3X a week & I love the way my face feels & looks!!! I'm telling you, try it once & you're hooked. I will use this forever!!!
This product makes my skin feel so smooth. It's definitely the best scrub I've ever used. I have combination skin, for reference.
Game changer - I struggle with post-acne dark spots and scarring and this seems to be helping with that as well as making my skin feel so smooth!
Excellent product! The smell is amazing and it left my skin super smooth!
I love this exfoliator. It's one of the best i've tried and you cannot beat the price. I don't usually leave reviews, but I had to make an exception for this product. Definitely a must try!

Ok so I was skeptical but I read the reviews and just went with it. When I tell y'all it feels like I just had a facial my pores look tiny and my blackheads look like they vanished and this is with ONE use. I'm so exciting this scrub works wonders. If you're like me and you suffer from black heads this is for YOU! I can definitely see how it can be harsh on the skin thought I wouldn't recommend for open acne or super sensitive skin.

I'm in my late twenties and I've been using this product for the past 3 months (I still have a lot of product left) and my skin feels so smooth, soft and bright! I was first afraid of the citrus in this since I have reactive sensitive skin but this never irritated my skin or caused breakouts. Highly recommend

I like the texture of this exfoliator really gives you that nice exfoliation w/o pressing down to scrub deeper. Smells good the fragrance it is not strong it all. Keeps my skin looking fresh and smoother. Too soon to tell if it'll help with the sebum I've been having since early fall and new hyperpigmentation I been experiencing from hormonal breakouts.

I am a junky when it comes to facial products. I have low end, to high end products. I get professional microdermabrasion. This product here is on a professional level. I have large pores, but this product has helped tremendously. 52 no makeup

Now this is an exfoliator!!!! A little bit of this goes a long way! I use a pea size for my entire face, I deal with dryness, flaking and sensitivity especially during the colder months. The container it comes in is glass, I am a huge fan of that. The consistency of this exfoliator is the softest, grittiest sand that gets the job done. The only thing I am careful of is not exfoliating too hard due to my sensitivity. Otherwise, this will be another staple in my cleansing routine.

A little goes a long way! first use, i accidentally used too much which is fine, no negative effects of it. i use 1-2 times per week and i love it so far! My skin is SO soft, my skin texture is wonderful in so many ways and i like that just a very small amount goes a long way so it's a product that i don't have to buy every single month since it lasts! I'm only 3 uses in and i notice a difference in my skin. i'm SO glad that i use this now and because it lasts, it's budget friendly! i WILL be buying again in the future! (i have sensitive skin and it is friendly to my skin as well!) I'm definately happy with my purchase.

(i have sensitive skin and it is friendly to my skin as well!) I'm definately happy with my purchase.

avis.titre: The only physical exfoliator I will ever use
avis.texte: It is very powerful, and I only need to use it once a week. Smell is fresh and not artificial. Your skin feels like a baby's!!! The best ever.

It may seem pricey but a little bit of this goes a long way. Gently scrub and don't use this everyday. A few times a week will do. I have a really sensitive skin and this scrub does not irritate my skin. The product smells great! Stock up when it's on sale!

I'm a freak when it comes to face scrubs, I've tried TONS and this one is a new favorite! I LOVE the scent, not overpowering but still a delightful scent for your face. I love the grit it has, it's not to tough or to light, just perfect. This might be a little pricey but worth it!

this brand is great. this product in particular is fantastic. it's a true microdermabrasion scrub, in regards to the granules and paste like texture (some brands have a couple "beads" in a product and call it a scrub). it's a fairly good dupe for Lancer Polish in terms of product texture, although you might not be able to use this one everyday because of the extra ingredients (clay, etc). This product is almost like a mask too.

avis.titre: This is exactly what I was looking for!
avis.texte: I love this stuff! I use once a week or so on my face to get soft and smooth. It's got a really good rough scrub - and that is exactly what I want.
I love how this mask cleans my pours! Non irritating and feels great after using!

This stuff is amazing and the smell is out of this world! I have serious acne prone/sensitive skin and I cannot stress enough how much it has helped the appearance and texture of my acne scarring. You do have to be careful not to scrub too hard or for too long, and my face usually does end up red after I wash it off. But I use it before bed and apply a good serum and moisturizer and in the morning my skin has a more even completion and feels silky smooth. I use about 1-2 times a week on WET skin, and definitely don't recommend using it on your lips. Plus, the best part is you honestly don't need a lot so it'll last you quite a while.

I think this product does exactly what it describes. It's not gentle in any way, so for my sensitive skin I can only scrub for about 30 seconds while my skin is wet. I wish I could use it more often, but twice a week is what they recommend.

I love this scrub! It doesn't strip my skin like all of the other ones I've tried. It leaves it feeling so soft, fresh and renewed. I use this only once a week because while I love it, my skin is very sensitive. I follow it with my other Derma E products and couldn't be happier!!
I love this face scrub, it buffs away any make-up and dead skin leaving my face so soft and smooth. I've received comments about my skin glowing.

I saw the high ratings for this product but wonder if most of them are fake. The product leaves a greasy film feeling on your skin.￼ My skin does not feel clean. There are many other products out there that do a better job. Mixing up your own honey and sugar scrub is way cheaper and does a better job.

avis.titre: I will most definitely buy this again
avis.texte: I try to use this product at least 2-3 times a week. I love the way it makes my face and neck feel. It is the one I will always use to get the dead skin off my face.

Just finished my second or third jar of this - it's one of my favorite scrubs. Good texture and nice scent, and my aging skin always looks refreshed after using it. Definitely recommend it and Derma E products in general - good quality at a fair price.
This is a great scrub and totally worth the price! After the first use I truly noticed a difference. Will definitely be buying this again!
Honestly I don't even know what to say other than this stuff is just so good and I love it. An absolutely wonderful product.

My wife and I both use this! I lucked out with naturally clear and soft skin, so this and a good sunscreen is just great for prepping my face for my phototherapy sessions. Meanwhile, she has facial hair that makes the skin on her chin and jawline a little thicker and tougher. When she uses this before a shave and a good moisturizer after (we like Pacifica) she comes out soft and super smooth! Best tip is to only use this every other day. It does scrub very well, and daily use might cause breakouts.
This stuff is amazing. It actually feels like it's exfoliating and won't irritate your (sensitive) skin. Smells great, too.

Ulta was doing the buy $30 worth of product from derm a and you get this free. I have used it twice and it's fantastic. I've suffered with adult acne the past few months and some cystic acne. This really made my skin feel soft, clean and smooth!!! It is a MUST buy

There is definitely a reason this product has basically no bad reviews. I have been struggling with a change in my skin over the past year or so and have spent hundreds of dollars trying to find products to help it. I struggle largely with redness, dryness, and overall poor texture. This solved all of those issues almost completely after just one use. This scrub does exactly what it says it will at a fraction of the cost of most other hyped up skincare brands. I wish I had found it sooner and saved myself the money.

I've looked for quite a while for a cheaper yet effective MD Scrub, I used the R+F MD paste for years but it's on the more expensive side and I was looking to spend less but same results. This is it. I absolutely can't get enough of the smell, it makes me happy.

avis.titre: My Skin is Smoother, Less Red from Scarring and Soft!
avis.texte: I use this product twice a week, as directed. I am in my 30s with adult acne-prone skin. I have red marks on my forehead, cheeks, and even my neck. I have only used this twice, but I have noticed a big difference in the redness and brownness of my acne scars. I first clean my face, then wet it again with lukewarm water. After that, I take about a dime size of this scrub and rub it very gently in circular motions on my face and neck where I have the scars. After that, I rinse with lukewarm water and pat to dry. It does make my face red afterwards, so I only use it at night. By the morning, however, my face is bright and smooth, and the acne scars have lessened. I have scars that are over ten years old, and this is helping to fade them! I highly recommend this!

avis.titre: New to exfoliation & I'm extremely impressed
avis.texte: I'm new to exfoliating my skin. I can't afford the regular facials and other treatments I've looked into, and I've never really exfoliated my skin. I'm in loveeeeeeee with this product! My skin is SO smooth afterwards, a little red if I scrub hard but I feel clean and fresh and I enjoy the light scent. And my acne scars are actually fading!!!
Actually helps my acne scars so much!! I notice when I use this regularly as directed my scars fade so quickly!

This is a must! It has the right size of exfoliating agents to get the job done. My skin feels so amazing, soft, and clears up any rough, dry patches. I love this! The scent is soft and delightful. This product brightens my skin and day every time I use it. I should note I don't have sensitive skin or acne. I do have dry to combinations skin. Now there are a couple things I've noticed. You MUST make sure you tighten that lid after ever use. Because I noticed the times I didn't, it formed a dry layer on top, but a tad bit of water took care of that. Another thing would be that, it made my dry areas feel a bit tight after using it but it's not anything my moisturizer can't handle. I still HIGHLY HIGHLY recommend!
The BEST microdermabrasion scrub that I have found so far. Love it!

First time trying this brand and have bought 3 more items since. This scrub is amazing. My face feels super soft and clean after using. The smell is very pleasant as well. I will def buy this again and again.
I LOOOVE this scrub! It smells so good and isn't irritating. The scrub is nice and fine instead of overly scratchy like a lot of scrubs.

avis.titre: Best Scrub I've used in years
avis.texte: I use this on my face in the shower. I love the way it works & makes my skin feel. I bought the travel/trial size & I'll be able to get at least 7 uses from it. I will definitely buy this again.

I LOVE THIS. It's honesty the main staple in my skin routine and it removes all those stubborn dry patches of skin on your face!! It's a must especially during the winter. Will continue to repurchase always.

I used this product because I had really bad acne scarring. It's been a year and has helped tremendously. My skin is so smooth and most of my scars have faded. I use this along with the nighttime vitamin c overnight cream
I love this project! It smells good, and makes my skin glow and feel amazing. I highly recommend it to anyone!

I have PCOS, which causes my face to break out very often + a lot of scars are left as a result. I've used this scrub twice now + haven't had any big breakouts since + the scars look like they're fading. Skin feels smoother. Smell is nice too.

avis.titre: SO FAR SO GOOD SENSITIVE SKIN SMOOTH
avis.texte: I don't usually leave reviews on Ulta because so many people do. But this product I could not ignore. I have tried a number of Microdemabrasion Scrubs for sentive combination skin. Nothing seemed to get my skin smooth. But this scrubs formulation works good for me. Remember people you have to use these items correctly for them to work. I cleanse my face first and then I apply this scrub to my wet face. I do gentle circles while apply a little pressure. Not too much pressure ladies and gents because you can harm your skin. I do it for about a minute. I rinse it off good then pat my face dry. I apply my dermatologist gel for my acne, let that sit and dry down. Then I apply my daily moisturizer. Once that dries down I then apply my ceramide serum. My skin is glowing! The scrub gives me smooth skin! I say give it a try! If anything changes I will do an update. But so far 1 time a week is all I need!
It's nice because it isn't a harsh exfoliation but it gets the job done very nicely. Skin looks and feels smoother after use. It also smells so good! Loving the Derma E brand.
Fantastic exfoliation, can be used gently or harder for a more abrasive scrub.

Absolutely obsessed with this product. I use it 1-2 times per week and sometimes a third of my skin is being difficult. Just a little pea size of the product after your face is washed and dry. This is where it changed for me. Patting skin dry while still in the warm shower made a significant difference than warm wet skin. My skin clears up in half the time and you don't need to rub hard at all, you have to be gentle with your face. Other than those recommendations it smells nice and fresh and I love this scrub. 100/10 I always recommend

avis.titre: The only face scrub I'll buy
avis.texte: This stuff is great - my favorite face scrub and the only one that I feel REALLY exfoliates my face.

avis.titre: I'd give it 6 stars if I could LOL
avis.texte: This stuff is awesome. Super light and soft on the face. I always had little clogged pores near my jawline and could never find a product that would help get rid of them, but this has worked! My skin is also very sensitive and dry. I def recommend and there's a travel size too!

This stuff is awesome! It smells absolutely devine. It has tiny little granuals in it so it exfoliates, and just a little on your hand, maybe the size of a dime, goes a really long way so it will last a good amount of time.

I started using this when i realized normal face scrubs weren't doing it for my dry patches and flakey skin- struggled with those problem areas on my nose and forehead. I LOVE this stuff, it smells SO good, a little goes a long way and it transformed my skin. I no longer struggle with any dryness or flaking skin, I noticed an improvement literally after the first use. My husband and I both use this a couple times a week. Skin feels so soft after using too. We are on our 2nd jar now 🙂

I have been in search of a really good facial scrub. I guess I am old school but my skin really prefers a manual exfoliator instead of a chemical one. It's been years and I've gone through dud after dud. Then I received a small sample tube of a very expensive high end scrub by Lancer, $75 I refuse to pay that much for an exfoliator. I just so happen to be looking through YouTube and saw a woman compare this to the Lancer scrub. I ran to Ulta and bought a bottle and bam it is exactly like it! I absolutely love it. It reminds me of one of my favorite scrubs by shiseido back when I worked for them in the early 90's. I know scrubs aren't for everyone but I love them well I love one that actually exfoliates as many have little beads that you can't even feel and do nothing to remove dead skin! I am so happy!
I am a huge fan of this scrub. The price is reasonable and it works just as well as similar products I have tried for more than twice the price. I'm on my third jar and love it!

It made my skin breakout at first but it's normal to purge when using new products! other than that, it's great! it makes my face feel so smooth and clean. I use it before bed twice a week, it's been helping my redness, scars, and pores! I recommend!

This is my first time , hearing/trying this brand and it is a life changer! I normally use Paulas choice products, too scared to venture out, however I was needing a scrub and I notice a significant difference after the first use! I use this and apply the DERMA E scar gel , and I loving the results already

I have very sensitive, dry skin and Derma E is the only brand I've discovered that has not caused issues. It has a neutral small and a nice feel to it. This scrub has done a great job of helping to clear/soften my face. I also use the serum for additional moisture.
